title: Cards and Tech View's Assigned Techs show the lead and line technicians
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 4 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz", "Jenny Wilson"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Jenny Wilson") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create an Approved work order for the case customer (e.g. "S1-644") with Lead Technician "Esther Howard" and three lines: "Line 1" given to Ralph Edwards and "Line 2" given to Dana Ortiz (Edit Line > Technicians), and "Line 3" with no labor technician.
  7. On the Schedule, give "Jenny Wilson" a shift on "S1-644" tomorrow 8:00–10:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Jenny Wilson's row at the start time > in the picker choose Choose lines and tick Line 3 > set the end time > save.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Open Fields to display and turn line technicians on.
  4. Read the avatar group on the card and hover each avatar.
  5. Pick Tech View, open the column chooser and turn Assigned Techs on.
  6. Read the avatar group in the row.
  7. Pick List and open its column chooser.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card shows a compact avatar group of 4: Esther Howard (lead) plus Ralph Edwards, Dana Ortiz and Jenny Wilson (the scheduled technician on Line 3 counts as that line's technician).
  • Tech View's Assigned Techs column shows the same 4-avatar group.
  • List does not offer an Assigned Techs column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-R1, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD Story 7 context note (scheduled technicians count as the line's technicians). Review Decisions DR-33. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): List's Columns shows an "Assigned Tech" column; the PRD (no column in List) is followed. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “Board View cards (when the line technicians field is on) and a new optional Assigned Techs column in Tech View show a compact avatar group: the lead technician plus the distinct technicians assigned to work order lines. List does not get this column.”
  • Story 7 context note: “this feature counts technicians scheduled on a line as that line’s technicians (S7-R1).”
